simple.meaning: קָצַע (qâtsaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to strip off, i.e. (partially) scrape ; by implication, to segregate (as an angle).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.short: to strip off, i.e. (partially) scrape ; by implication, to segregate (as an angle)
definitions.full: H7106. qatsa ' I. קָצַע verb scrape, scrape off (Late Hebrew id. , also קְצִיעָה = Biblical Hebrew, קְצִיעֲהָא ᵑ7 , Arabic fine dust ); — Hiph`il id. Imperfect 3masculine singular יַקְצִעַ אֶתהַֿבַּיִת Lev 14:41 .

occurrences.englishText: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.
